input: Henry de Bohun, 1st Earl of Hereford, died on what date?

input: When did the Bohuns begin to take a foremost place among the Marches?

After the death of Humphrey de Bohun, 5th Earl of Hereford, during the Battle of Evesham in 1265, his son Humphrey VI inherited the title at a young age. The subsequent period saw the Bohuns consolidate their position through strategic marriages, royal patronage, and military service. They gained further prominence during the reign of Edward I, who relied on trusted Marcher lords like the Bohuns to conquer and administer Wales. The family's position was solidified when they were appointed to key offices and received extensive grants of Welsh lands following the conquest of Wales.
